"""Run existing native acceptance workflows with read-only BS1 observations."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import runpy
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from unittest.mock import patch

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'scripts'))
import s760_runtime

class ObservedRuntime(s760_runtime.NativeRuntime):
    def _start(self,timeout):
        folder=self.config.state_dir.resolve()/'bs1-observer'
        folder.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
        wrapper=folder/'wrapper.lua'
        observer=folder/'observer.lua'
        shutil.copyfile(HERE/'observer.lua',observer)
        wrapper.write_text('dofile('+json.dumps((ROOT/'scripts/s760_runtime.lua').as_posix())+')\n'
                           +'dofile('+json.dumps(observer.as_posix())+')\n',encoding='utf-8')
        launch=subprocess.Popen
        def observed(command,**kwargs):
            command=list(command)
            command[command.index('-autoboot_script')+1]=str(wrapper)
            kwargs['env']['BS1_OBSERVER_DIR']=folder.as_posix()
            return launch([*command,'-log'],**kwargs)
        self.observation_folder=folder
        self.snapshot_count=0
        with patch('s760_runtime.subprocess.Popen',side_effect=observed):
            super()._start(timeout)

    def request(self,operation,**kwargs):
        result=super().request(operation,**kwargs)
        if operation=='frames':
            self.snapshot_count+=1
            tag=f'frame-{self.snapshot_count:02}'
            temporary=self.observation_folder/'snapshot-request.tmp'
            temporary.write_text(tag,encoding='ascii')
            temporary.replace(self.observation_folder/'snapshot-request.txt')
            deadline=time.monotonic()+10
            while not (self.observation_folder/(tag+'.json')).exists():
                if self.process.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError('Observer process stopped')
                if time.monotonic()>deadline:raise TimeoutError('Read-only snapshot timed out')
                time.sleep(.02)
        return result

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--workflow',choices=('stereo','scsi-save'),required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output',type=Path,required=True)
    args=parser.parse_args()
    workflow=ROOT/'scripts'/('verify_native_sampling_input.py' if args.workflow=='stereo' else 'verify_native_scsi_save.py')
    files=[Path(__file__),HERE/'observer.lua',workflow,ROOT/'scripts/s760_runtime.py',ROOT/'scripts/s760_runtime.lua',ROOT/'mame-source/mames760.exe',ROOT/'S760224.IMG',ROOT/'roms/BOOT/Roland_S-760_v1.11.BIN']
    identity={str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in files}
    sys.argv=[str(workflow),'--state-dir',str(args.output.resolve())]
    if args.workflow=='stereo':
        sys.argv+=['--blank-disk',str(ROOT/'docs/ic20-hle-findings/chatGPT-work/media-verification-20261012-065549/formatted.img')]
    with patch.object(s760_runtime,'NativeRuntime',ObservedRuntime):
        runpy.run_path(str(workflow),run_name='__main__')
    assert all(hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==identity[str(p.relative_to(ROOT))] for p in files), 'Input changed during observation'
    (args.output/'observer-identities.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,indent=2)+'\n')

if __name__=='__main__':main()

"""Relax only emitted inverse-Jcc/LJMP pairs; preserve all control-flow targets."""
import struct,re,pypcode
def relax(a,base):
 old=bytes(a.code); oldlabels=dict(a.labels)
 ctx=pypcode.Context('MCS96:LE:16:default')
 before=ctx.disassemble(old,base_address=base).instructions
 candidates={index-3:(old[index-3]^8,label) for index,label,after in a.fixups if index>=3 and 0xd0<=old[index-3]<=0xdf and old[index-2:index]==bytes([3,0xe7])}
 selected=set()
 def mapped(offset):return offset-3*sum(start<offset for start in selected)
 while True:
  changed=False
  for start,(op,label) in candidates.items():
   if start in selected:continue
   target=oldlabels[label]-base
   distance=mapped(target)-(3 if target>start else 0)-(mapped(start)+2)
   if -128<=distance<=127:selected.add(start);changed=True
  if not changed:break
 result=bytearray();i=0
 while i<len(old):
  if i in selected:
   op,label=candidates[i];disp=mapped(oldlabels[label]-base)-(len(result)+2)
   assert -128<=disp<=127
   result.extend([op,disp&255]);i+=5
  else:result.append(old[i]);i+=1
 for index,label,after in a.fixups:
  if index-3 in selected:continue
  newindex=mapped(index);target=mapped(oldlabels[label]-base)
  struct.pack_into('<H',result,newindex,(target-(newindex+2))&65535)
 a.labels={k:base+mapped(v-base) for k,v in oldlabels.items()}
 after=ctx.disassemble(bytes(result),base_address=base).instructions
 assert sum(i.length for i in after)==len(result)
 starts={i.addr.offset for i in after}
 # Verify decoded branch/call destinations against old control-flow edges.
 afterby={i.addr.offset:i for i in after}
 for ins in before:
  offset=ins.addr.offset-base
  if offset in selected:
   new=afterby[base+mapped(offset)]
   assert new.mnem.startswith('J')
   assert int(new.body,16)==a.labels[candidates[offset][1]]
  elif offset-2 in selected:continue
  elif ins.mnem in ('LJMP','LCALL','JE','JNE','JC','JNC','JH','JNH','JBS','JBC'):
   targets=re.findall(r'0x[0-9a-fA-F]+',ins.body)
   assert targets,(ins.mnem,ins.body)
   target=int(targets[-1],16)
   new=afterby[base+mapped(offset)]
   expected=base+mapped(target-base)
   actual=int(re.findall(r'0x[0-9a-fA-F]+',new.body)[-1],16)
   assert actual==expected,(ins.mnem,ins.body,new.body,expected)
   assert actual in starts
 a.code=result
 a.rows=[dict(pc=i.addr.offset,bytes=bytes(result[i.addr.offset-base:i.addr.offset-base+i.length]).hex(),text=i.mnem+' '+i.body) for i in after]
 a.relaxation=dict(before=len(old),after=len(result),saved=len(old)-len(result),branches=len(selected))
 return bytes(result)

"""Run existing native acceptance workflows with read-only BS1 observations."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import runpy
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from unittest.mock import patch

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'scripts'))
import s760_runtime

class ObservedRuntime(s760_runtime.NativeRuntime):
    def _start(self,timeout):
        folder=self.config.state_dir.resolve()/'bs1-observer'
        folder.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
        wrapper=folder/'wrapper.lua'
        observer=folder/'observer.lua'
        shutil.copyfile(HERE/'observer.lua',observer)
        wrapper.write_text('dofile('+json.dumps((ROOT/'scripts/s760_runtime.lua').as_posix())+')\n'
                           +'dofile('+json.dumps(observer.as_posix())+')\n',encoding='utf-8')
        launch=subprocess.Popen
        def observed(command,**kwargs):
            command=list(command)
            command[command.index('-autoboot_script')+1]=str(wrapper)
            kwargs['env']['BS1_OBSERVER_DIR']=folder.as_posix()
            return launch([*command,'-log'],**kwargs)
        self.observation_folder=folder
        self.snapshot_count=0
        with patch('s760_runtime.subprocess.Popen',side_effect=observed):
            super()._start(timeout)

    def request(self,operation,**kwargs):
        result=super().request(operation,**kwargs)
        if operation=='frames':
            self.snapshot_count+=1
            tag=f'frame-{self.snapshot_count:02}'
            temporary=self.observation_folder/'snapshot-request.tmp'
            temporary.write_text(tag,encoding='ascii')
            temporary.replace(self.observation_folder/'snapshot-request.txt')
            deadline=time.monotonic()+10
            while not (self.observation_folder/(tag+'.json')).exists():
                if self.process.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError('Observer process stopped')
                if time.monotonic()>deadline:raise TimeoutError('Read-only snapshot timed out')
                time.sleep(.02)
        return result

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--workflow',choices=('stereo','scsi-save'),required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output',type=Path,required=True)
    args=parser.parse_args()
    workflow=ROOT/'scripts'/('verify_native_sampling_input.py' if args.workflow=='stereo' else 'verify_native_scsi_save.py')
    files=[Path(__file__),HERE/'observer.lua',workflow,ROOT/'scripts/s760_runtime.py',ROOT/'scripts/s760_runtime.lua',ROOT/'mame-source/mames760.exe',ROOT/'S760224.IMG',ROOT/'roms/BOOT/Roland_S-760_v1.11.BIN']
    identity={str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in files}
    sys.argv=[str(workflow),'--state-dir',str(args.output.resolve())]
    if args.workflow=='stereo':
        sys.argv+=['--blank-disk',str(ROOT/'docs/ic20-hle-findings/chatGPT-work/media-verification-20261012-065549/formatted.img')]
    with patch.object(s760_runtime,'NativeRuntime',ObservedRuntime):
        runpy.run_path(str(workflow),run_name='__main__')
    assert all(hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==identity[str(p.relative_to(ROOT))] for p in files), 'Input changed during observation'
    (args.output/'observer-identities.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,indent=2)+'\n')

if __name__=='__main__':main()

import struct,re,pypcode
def relax(a,base):

 ctx=pypcode.Context('MCS96:LE:16:default')
 before=ctx.disassemble(old,base_address=base).instructions
 candidates={index-3:(old[index-3]^8,label) for index,label,after in a.fixups if index>=3 and 0xd0<=old[index-3]<=0xdf and old[index-2:index]==bytes([3,0xe7])}
 selected=set()
 def mapped(offset):return offset-3*sum(start<offset for start in selected)
 while True:
  changed=False
  for start,(op,label) in candidates.items():
   if start in selected:continue
   target=oldlabels[label]-base
   distance=mapped(target)-(3 if target>start else 0)-(mapped(start)+2)
   if -128<=distance<=127:selected.add(start);changed=True
  if not changed:break
 result=bytearray();i=0
 while i<len(old):
  if i in selected:
   op,label=candidates[i];disp=mapped(oldlabels[label]-base)-(len(result)+2)
   assert -128<=disp<=127
   result.extend([op,disp&255]);i+=5
  else:result.append(old[i]);i+=1
 for index,label,after in a.fixups:
  if index-3 in selected:continue
  newindex=mapped(index);target=mapped(oldlabels[label]-base)
  struct.pack_into('<H',result,newindex,(target-(newindex+2))&65535)
 a.labels={k:base+mapped(v-base) for k,v in oldlabels.items()}
 after=ctx.disassemble(bytes(result),base_address=base).instructions
 assert sum(i.length for i in after)==len(result)
 starts={i.addr.offset for i in after}
 # Verify decoded branch/call destinations against old control-flow edges.
 afterby={i.addr.offset:i for i in after}
 for ins in before:
  offset=ins.addr.offset-base
  if offset in selected:
   new=afterby[base+mapped(offset)]
   assert new.mnem.startswith('J')
   assert int(new.body,16)==a.labels[candidates[offset][1]]
  elif offset-2 in selected:continue
  elif ins.mnem in ('LJMP','LCALL','JE','JNE','JC','JNC','JH','JNH','JBS','JBC'):
   targets=re.findall(r'0x[0-9a-fA-F]+',ins.body)
   assert targets,(ins.mnem,ins.body)
   target=int(targets[-1],16)
   new=afterby[base+mapped(offset)]
   expected=base+mapped(target-base)
   actual=int(re.findall(r'0x[0-9a-fA-F]+',new.body)[-1],16)
   assert actual==expected,(ins.mnem,ins.body,new.body,expected)
   assert actual in starts

 a.relaxation=dict(before=len(old),after=len(result),saved=len(old)-len(result),branches=len(selected))

class Asm:
 def __init__(self): self.code=bytearray();self.labels={};self.fixups=[];self.rows=[]
 @property
 def pc(self):return BASE+len(self.code)
 def label(self,n):assert n not in self.labels;self.labels[n]=self.pc
 def emit(self,*b):self.code.extend(b)
 def word(self,n):self.code.extend(struct.pack('<H',n&65535))
 def imm(self,r,n):self.emit(0xa1);self.word(n);self.emit(r)
 def byte(self,r,n):self.emit(0xb1,n&255,r)
 def ld(self,r,a):self.emit(0xa3,1);self.word(a);self.emit(r)
 def ldb(self,r,a):self.emit(0xb3,1);self.word(a);self.emit(r)
 def st(self,r,a):self.emit(0xc3,1);self.word(a);self.emit(r)
 def stb(self,r,a):self.emit(0xc7,1);self.word(a);self.emit(r)
 def mov(self,r,s):self.emit(0xa0,s,r)
 def clr(self,r):self.emit(1,r)
 def cmp(self,r,n):self.emit(0x89);self.word(n);self.emit(r)
 def cmpb(self,r,n):self.emit(0x99,n&255,r)
 def jmp(self,label,op=0xe7):
  self.emit(op);self.fixups.append((len(self.code),label,self.pc+2));self.word(0)
 def call(self,label):self.jmp(label,0xef)
 def cond(self,op,label):
  # Inverse conditional skips a long jump, avoiding hidden short-branch limits.
  self.emit(op^8,3);self.jmp(label)
 def finish(self):
  for index,label,after in self.fixups:
   assert label in self.labels,label
   self.code[index:index+2]=struct.pack('<H',(self.labels[label]-after)&65535)
  ctx=pypcode.Context('MCS96:LE:16:default')
  ins=ctx.disassemble(bytes(self.code),base_address=BASE).instructions
  assert sum(i.length for i in ins)==len(self.code)
  starts={i.addr.offset for i in ins}
  assert all(v in starts for k,v in self.labels.items() if k!='code_end')
  for i in ins:
   if i.mnem in ('LJMP','LCALL','JE','JNE','JC','JNC','JH','JNH'):
    assert int(i.body,16) in starts,(i.mnem,i.body)

  from relax import relax
  return relax(self,BASE)

"""Run existing native acceptance workflows with read-only BS1 observations."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import runpy
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from unittest.mock import patch

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'scripts'))
import s760_runtime

class ObservedRuntime(s760_runtime.NativeRuntime):
    def _start(self,timeout):
        folder=self.config.state_dir.resolve()/'bs1-observer'
        folder.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
        wrapper=folder/'wrapper.lua'
        observer=folder/'observer.lua'
        shutil.copyfile(HERE/'observer.lua',observer)
        wrapper.write_text('dofile('+json.dumps((ROOT/'scripts/s760_runtime.lua').as_posix())+')\n'
                           +'dofile('+json.dumps(observer.as_posix())+')\n',encoding='utf-8')
        launch=subprocess.Popen
        def observed(command,**kwargs):
            command=list(command)
            command[command.index('-autoboot_script')+1]=str(wrapper)
            kwargs['env']['BS1_OBSERVER_DIR']=folder.as_posix()
            return launch([*command,'-log'],**kwargs)
        self.observation_folder=folder
        self.snapshot_count=0
        with patch('s760_runtime.subprocess.Popen',side_effect=observed):
            super()._start(timeout)

    def request(self,operation,**kwargs):
        result=super().request(operation,**kwargs)
        if operation=='frames':
            self.snapshot_count+=1
            tag=f'frame-{self.snapshot_count:02}'
            temporary=self.observation_folder/'snapshot-request.tmp'
            temporary.write_text(tag,encoding='ascii')
            temporary.replace(self.observation_folder/'snapshot-request.txt')
            deadline=time.monotonic()+10
            while not (self.observation_folder/(tag+'.json')).exists():
                if self.process.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError('Observer process stopped')
                if time.monotonic()>deadline:raise TimeoutError('Read-only snapshot timed out')
                time.sleep(.02)
        return result

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--workflow',choices=('stereo','scsi-save'),required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output',type=Path,required=True)
    args=parser.parse_args()
    workflow=ROOT/'scripts'/('verify_native_sampling_input.py' if args.workflow=='stereo' else 'verify_native_scsi_save.py')
    files=[Path(__file__),HERE/'observer.lua',workflow,ROOT/'scripts/s760_runtime.py',ROOT/'scripts/s760_runtime.lua',ROOT/'mame-source/mames760.exe',ROOT/'S760224.IMG',ROOT/'roms/BOOT/Roland_S-760_v1.11.BIN']
    identity={str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in files}
    sys.argv=[str(workflow),'--state-dir',str(args.output.resolve())]
    if args.workflow=='stereo':
        sys.argv+=['--blank-disk',str(ROOT/'docs/ic20-hle-findings/chatGPT-work/media-verification-20261012-065549/formatted.img')]
    with patch.object(s760_runtime,'NativeRuntime',ObservedRuntime):
        runpy.run_path(str(workflow),run_name='__main__')
    assert all(hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==identity[str(p.relative_to(ROOT))] for p in files), 'Input changed during observation'
    (args.output/'observer-identities.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,indent=2)+'\n')

if __name__=='__main__':main()

"""Relax only emitted inverse-Jcc/LJMP pairs; preserve all control-flow targets."""
import struct,re,pypcode
def relax(a,base):
 old=bytes(a.code); oldlabels=dict(a.labels)
 ctx=pypcode.Context('MCS96:LE:16:default')
 before=ctx.disassemble(old,base_address=base).instructions
 candidates={index-3:(old[index-3]^8,label) for index,label,after in a.fixups if index>=3 and 0xd0<=old[index-3]<=0xdf and old[index-2:index]==bytes([3,0xe7])}
 selected=set()
 def mapped(offset):return offset-3*sum(start<offset for start in selected)
 while True:
  changed=False
  for start,(op,label) in candidates.items():
   if start in selected:continue
   target=oldlabels[label]-base
   distance=mapped(target)-(3 if target>start else 0)-(mapped(start)+2)
   if -128<=distance<=127:selected.add(start);changed=True
  if not changed:break
 result=bytearray();i=0
 while i<len(old):
  if i in selected:
   op,label=candidates[i];disp=mapped(oldlabels[label]-base)-(len(result)+2)
   assert -128<=disp<=127
   result.extend([op,disp&255]);i+=5
  else:result.append(old[i]);i+=1
 for index,label,after in a.fixups:
  if index-3 in selected:continue
  newindex=mapped(index);target=mapped(oldlabels[label]-base)
  struct.pack_into('<H',result,newindex,(target-(newindex+2))&65535)
 a.labels={k:base+mapped(v-base) for k,v in oldlabels.items()}
 after=ctx.disassemble(bytes(result),base_address=base).instructions
 assert sum(i.length for i in after)==len(result)
 starts={i.addr.offset for i in after}
 # Verify decoded branch/call destinations against old control-flow edges.
 afterby={i.addr.offset:i for i in after}
 for ins in before:
  offset=ins.addr.offset-base
  if offset in selected:
   new=afterby[base+mapped(offset)]
   assert new.mnem.startswith('J')
   assert int(new.body,16)==a.labels[candidates[offset][1]]
  elif offset-2 in selected:continue
  elif ins.mnem in ('LJMP','LCALL','JE','JNE','JC','JNC','JH','JNH','JBS','JBC'):
   targets=re.findall(r'0x[0-9a-fA-F]+',ins.body)
   assert targets,(ins.mnem,ins.body)
   target=int(targets[-1],16)
   new=afterby[base+mapped(offset)]
   expected=base+mapped(target-base)
   actual=int(re.findall(r'0x[0-9a-fA-F]+',new.body)[-1],16)
   assert actual==expected,(ins.mnem,ins.body,new.body,expected)
   assert actual in starts
 a.code=result
 a.rows=[dict(pc=i.addr.offset,bytes=bytes(result[i.addr.offset-base:i.addr.offset-base+i.length]).hex(),text=i.mnem+' '+i.body) for i in after]
 a.relaxation=dict(before=len(old),after=len(result),saved=len(old)-len(result),branches=len(selected))
 return bytes(result)

"""Run existing native acceptance workflows with read-only BS1 observations."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import runpy
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from unittest.mock import patch

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'scripts'))
import s760_runtime

class ObservedRuntime(s760_runtime.NativeRuntime):
    def _start(self,timeout):
        folder=self.config.state_dir.resolve()/'bs1-observer'
        folder.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
        wrapper=folder/'wrapper.lua'
        observer=folder/'observer.lua'
        shutil.copyfile(HERE/'observer.lua',observer)
        wrapper.write_text('dofile('+json.dumps((ROOT/'scripts/s760_runtime.lua').as_posix())+')\n'
                           +'dofile('+json.dumps(observer.as_posix())+')\n',encoding='utf-8')
        launch=subprocess.Popen
        def observed(command,**kwargs):
            command=list(command)
            command[command.index('-autoboot_script')+1]=str(wrapper)
            kwargs['env']['BS1_OBSERVER_DIR']=folder.as_posix()
            return launch([*command,'-log'],**kwargs)
        self.observation_folder=folder
        self.snapshot_count=0
        with patch('s760_runtime.subprocess.Popen',side_effect=observed):
            super()._start(timeout)

    def request(self,operation,**kwargs):
        result=super().request(operation,**kwargs)
        if operation=='frames':
            self.snapshot_count+=1
            tag=f'frame-{self.snapshot_count:02}'
            temporary=self.observation_folder/'snapshot-request.tmp'
            temporary.write_text(tag,encoding='ascii')
            temporary.replace(self.observation_folder/'snapshot-request.txt')
            deadline=time.monotonic()+10
            while not (self.observation_folder/(tag+'.json')).exists():
                if self.process.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError('Observer process stopped')
                if time.monotonic()>deadline:raise TimeoutError('Read-only snapshot timed out')
                time.sleep(.02)
        return result

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--workflow',choices=('stereo','scsi-save'),required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output',type=Path,required=True)
    args=parser.parse_args()
    workflow=ROOT/'scripts'/('verify_native_sampling_input.py' if args.workflow=='stereo' else 'verify_native_scsi_save.py')
    files=[Path(__file__),HERE/'observer.lua',workflow,ROOT/'scripts/s760_runtime.py',ROOT/'scripts/s760_runtime.lua',ROOT/'mame-source/mames760.exe',ROOT/'S760224.IMG',ROOT/'roms/BOOT/Roland_S-760_v1.11.BIN']
    identity={str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in files}
    sys.argv=[str(workflow),'--state-dir',str(args.output.resolve())]
    if args.workflow=='stereo':
        sys.argv+=['--blank-disk',str(ROOT/'docs/ic20-hle-findings/chatGPT-work/media-verification-20261012-065549/formatted.img')]
    with patch.object(s760_runtime,'NativeRuntime',ObservedRuntime):
        runpy.run_path(str(workflow),run_name='__main__')
    assert all(hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==identity[str(p.relative_to(ROOT))] for p in files), 'Input changed during observation'
    (args.output/'observer-identities.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,indent=2)+'\n')

if __name__=='__main__':main()

"""Relax only emitted inverse-Jcc/LJMP pairs; preserve all control-flow targets."""
import struct,re,pypcode
def relax(a,base):
 old=bytes(a.code); oldlabels=dict(a.labels)
 ctx=pypcode.Context('MCS96:LE:16:default')
 before=ctx.disassemble(old,base_address=base).instructions
 candidates={index-3:(old[index-3]^8,label) for index,label,after in a.fixups if index>=3 and 0xd0<=old[index-3]<=0xdf and old[index-2:index]==bytes([3,0xe7])}
 selected=set()
 def mapped(offset):return offset-3*sum(start<offset for start in selected)
 while True:
  changed=False
  for start,(op,label) in candidates.items():
   if start in selected:continue
   target=oldlabels[label]-base
   distance=mapped(target)-(3 if target>start else 0)-(mapped(start)+2)
   if -128<=distance<=127:selected.add(start);changed=True
  if not changed:break
 result=bytearray();i=0
 while i<len(old):
  if i in selected:
   op,label=candidates[i];disp=mapped(oldlabels[label]-base)-(len(result)+2)
   assert -128<=disp<=127
   result.extend([op,disp&255]);i+=5
  else:result.append(old[i]);i+=1
 for index,label,after in a.fixups:
  if index-3 in selected:continue
  newindex=mapped(index);target=mapped(oldlabels[label]-base)
  struct.pack_into('<H',result,newindex,(target-(newindex+2))&65535)
 a.labels={k:base+mapped(v-base) for k,v in oldlabels.items()}
 after=ctx.disassemble(bytes(result),base_address=base).instructions
 assert sum(i.length for i in after)==len(result)
 starts={i.addr.offset for i in after}
 # Verify decoded branch/call destinations against old control-flow edges.
 afterby={i.addr.offset:i for i in after}
 for ins in before:
  offset=ins.addr.offset-base
  if offset in selected:
   new=afterby[base+mapped(offset)]
   assert new.mnem.startswith('J')
   assert int(new.body,16)==a.labels[candidates[offset][1]]
  elif offset-2 in selected:continue
  elif ins.mnem in ('LJMP','LCALL','JE','JNE','JC','JNC','JH','JNH','JBS','JBC'):
   targets=re.findall(r'0x[0-9a-fA-F]+',ins.body)
   assert targets,(ins.mnem,ins.body)
   target=int(targets[-1],16)
   new=afterby[base+mapped(offset)]
   expected=base+mapped(target-base)
   actual=int(re.findall(r'0x[0-9a-fA-F]+',new.body)[-1],16)
   assert actual==expected,(ins.mnem,ins.body,new.body,expected)
   assert actual in starts
 a.code=result
 a.rows=[dict(pc=i.addr.offset,bytes=bytes(result[i.addr.offset-base:i.addr.offset-base+i.length]).hex(),text=i.mnem+' '+i.body) for i in after]
 a.relaxation=dict(before=len(old),after=len(result),saved=len(old)-len(result),branches=len(selected))
 return bytes(result)

class Asm:
 def __init__(self): self.code=bytearray();self.labels={};self.fixups=[];self.rows=[]
 @property
 def pc(self):return BASE+len(self.code)
 def label(self,n):assert n not in self.labels;self.labels[n]=self.pc
 def emit(self,*b):self.code.extend(b)
 def word(self,n):self.code.extend(struct.pack('<H',n&65535))
 def imm(self,r,n):self.emit(0xa1);self.word(n);self.emit(r)
 def byte(self,r,n):self.emit(0xb1,n&255,r)
 def ld(self,r,a):self.emit(0xa3,1);self.word(a);self.emit(r)
 def ldb(self,r,a):self.emit(0xb3,1);self.word(a);self.emit(r)
 def st(self,r,a):self.emit(0xc3,1);self.word(a);self.emit(r)
 def stb(self,r,a):self.emit(0xc7,1);self.word(a);self.emit(r)
 def mov(self,r,s):self.emit(0xa0,s,r)
 def clr(self,r):self.emit(1,r)
 def cmp(self,r,n):self.emit(0x89);self.word(n);self.emit(r)
 def cmpb(self,r,n):self.emit(0x99,n&255,r)
 def jmp(self,label,op=0xe7):
  self.emit(op);self.fixups.append((len(self.code),label,self.pc+2));self.word(0)
 def call(self,label):self.jmp(label,0xef)
 def cond(self,op,label):
  # Inverse conditional skips a long jump, avoiding hidden short-branch limits.
  self.emit(op^8,3);self.jmp(label)
 def finish(self):
  for index,label,after in self.fixups:
   assert label in self.labels,label
   self.code[index:index+2]=struct.pack('<H',(self.labels[label]-after)&65535)
  ctx=pypcode.Context('MCS96:LE:16:default')
  ins=ctx.disassemble(bytes(self.code),base_address=BASE).instructions
  assert sum(i.length for i in ins)==len(self.code)
  starts={i.addr.offset for i in ins}
  assert all(v in starts for k,v in self.labels.items() if k!='code_end')
  for i in ins:
   if i.mnem in ('LJMP','LCALL','JE','JNE','JC','JNC','JH','JNH'):
    assert int(i.body,16) in starts,(i.mnem,i.body)
  self.rows=[dict(pc=i.addr.offset,bytes=bytes(self.code[i.addr.offset-BASE:i.addr.offset-BASE+i.length]).hex(),text=i.mnem+' '+i.body) for i in ins]
  from relax import relax
  return relax(self,BASE)

"""Run existing native acceptance workflows with read-only BS1 observations."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import runpy
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from unittest.mock import patch

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'scripts'))
import s760_runtime

class ObservedRuntime(s760_runtime.NativeRuntime):
    def _start(self,timeout):
        folder=self.config.state_dir.resolve()/'bs1-observer'
        folder.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
        wrapper=folder/'wrapper.lua'
        observer=folder/'observer.lua'
        shutil.copyfile(HERE/'observer.lua',observer)
        wrapper.write_text('dofile('+json.dumps((ROOT/'scripts/s760_runtime.lua').as_posix())+')\n'
                           +'dofile('+json.dumps(observer.as_posix())+')\n',encoding='utf-8')
        launch=subprocess.Popen
        def observed(command,**kwargs):
            command=list(command)
            command[command.index('-autoboot_script')+1]=str(wrapper)
            kwargs['env']['BS1_OBSERVER_DIR']=folder.as_posix()
            return launch([*command,'-log'],**kwargs)
        self.observation_folder=folder
        self.snapshot_count=0
        with patch('s760_runtime.subprocess.Popen',side_effect=observed):
            super()._start(timeout)

    def request(self,operation,**kwargs):
        result=super().request(operation,**kwargs)
        if operation=='frames':
            self.snapshot_count+=1
            tag=f'frame-{self.snapshot_count:02}'
            temporary=self.observation_folder/'snapshot-request.tmp'
            temporary.write_text(tag,encoding='ascii')
            temporary.replace(self.observation_folder/'snapshot-request.txt')
            deadline=time.monotonic()+10
            while not (self.observation_folder/(tag+'.json')).exists():
                if self.process.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError('Observer process stopped')
                if time.monotonic()>deadline:raise TimeoutError('Read-only snapshot timed out')
                time.sleep(.02)
        return result

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--workflow',choices=('stereo','scsi-save'),required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output',type=Path,required=True)
    args=parser.parse_args()
    workflow=ROOT/'scripts'/('verify_native_sampling_input.py' if args.workflow=='stereo' else 'verify_native_scsi_save.py')
    files=[Path(__file__),HERE/'observer.lua',workflow,ROOT/'scripts/s760_runtime.py',ROOT/'scripts/s760_runtime.lua',ROOT/'mame-source/mames760.exe',ROOT/'S760224.IMG',ROOT/'roms/BOOT/Roland_S-760_v1.11.BIN']
    identity={str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in files}
    sys.argv=[str(workflow),'--state-dir',str(args.output.resolve())]
    if args.workflow=='stereo':
        sys.argv+=['--blank-disk',str(ROOT/'docs/ic20-hle-findings/chatGPT-work/media-verification-20261012-065549/formatted.img')]
    with patch.object(s760_runtime,'NativeRuntime',ObservedRuntime):
        runpy.run_path(str(workflow),run_name='__main__')
    assert all(hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==identity[str(p.relative_to(ROOT))] for p in files), 'Input changed during observation'
    (args.output/'observer-identities.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,indent=2)+'\n')

if __name__=='__main__':main()

def relax(a,base):

 before=ctx.disassemble(old,base_address=base).instructions
 candidates={index-3:(old[index-3]^8,label) for index,label,after in a.fixups if index>=3 and 0xd0<=old[index-3]<=0xdf and old[index-2:index]==bytes([3,0xe7])}
 selected=set()
 def mapped(offset):return offset-3*sum(start<offset for start in selected)
 while True:
  changed=False
  for start,(op,label) in candidates.items():
   if start in selected:continue
   target=oldlabels[label]-base
   distance=mapped(target)-(3 if target>start else 0)-(mapped(start)+2)
   if -128<=distance<=127:selected.add(start);changed=True
  if not changed:break
 result=bytearray();i=0
 while i<len(old):
  if i in selected:
   op,label=candidates[i];disp=mapped(oldlabels[label]-base)-(len(result)+2)
   assert -128<=disp<=127
   result.extend([op,disp&255]);i+=5
  else:result.append(old[i]);i+=1
 for index,label,after in a.fixups:
  if index-3 in selected:continue
  newindex=mapped(index);target=mapped(oldlabels[label]-base)
  struct.pack_into('<H',result,newindex,(target-(newindex+2))&65535)
 a.labels={k:base+mapped(v-base) for k,v in oldlabels.items()}
 after=ctx.disassemble(bytes(result),base_address=base).instructions
 assert sum(i.length for i in after)==len(result)
 starts={i.addr.offset for i in after}
 # Verify decoded branch/call destinations against old control-flow edges.
 afterby={i.addr.offset:i for i in after}
 for ins in before:
  offset=ins.addr.offset-base
  if offset in selected:
   new=afterby[base+mapped(offset)]
   assert new.mnem.startswith('J')
   assert int(new.body,16)==a.labels[candidates[offset][1]]
  elif offset-2 in selected:continue
  elif ins.mnem in ('LJMP','LCALL','JE','JNE','JC','JNC','JH','JNH','JBS','JBC'):
   targets=re.findall(r'0x[0-9a-fA-F]+',ins.body)
   assert targets,(ins.mnem,ins.body)
   target=int(targets[-1],16)
   new=afterby[base+mapped(offset)]
   expected=base+mapped(target-base)
   actual=int(re.findall(r'0x[0-9a-fA-F]+',new.body)[-1],16)
   assert actual==expected,(ins.mnem,ins.body,new.body,expected)

class Asm:

 @property
 def pc(self):return BASE+len(self.code)
 def label(self,n):assert n not in self.labels;self.labels[n]=self.pc
 def emit(self,*b):self.code.extend(b)
 def word(self,n):self.code.extend(struct.pack('<H',n&65535))
 def imm(self,r,n):self.emit(0xa1);self.word(n);self.emit(r)
 def byte(self,r,n):self.emit(0xb1,n&255,r)
 def ld(self,r,a):self.emit(0xa3,1);self.word(a);self.emit(r)
 def ldb(self,r,a):self.emit(0xb3,1);self.word(a);self.emit(r)
 def st(self,r,a):self.emit(0xc3,1);self.word(a);self.emit(r)
 def stb(self,r,a):self.emit(0xc7,1);self.word(a);self.emit(r)
 def mov(self,r,s):self.emit(0xa0,s,r)
 def clr(self,r):self.emit(1,r)
 def cmp(self,r,n):self.emit(0x89);self.word(n);self.emit(r)
 def cmpb(self,r,n):self.emit(0x99,n&255,r)
 def jmp(self,label,op=0xe7):
  self.emit(op);self.fixups.append((len(self.code),label,self.pc+2));self.word(0)
 def call(self,label):self.jmp(label,0xef)
 def cond(self,op,label):
  # Inverse conditional skips a long jump, avoiding hidden short-branch limits.
  self.emit(op^8,3);self.jmp(label)
 def finish(self):
  for index,label,after in self.fixups:
   assert label in self.labels,label
   self.code[index:index+2]=struct.pack('<H',(self.labels[label]-after)&65535)
  ctx=pypcode.Context('MCS96:LE:16:default')
  ins=ctx.disassemble(bytes(self.code),base_address=BASE).instructions

  starts={i.addr.offset for i in ins}
  assert all(v in starts for k,v in self.labels.items() if k!='code_end')

"""Run existing native acceptance workflows with read-only BS1 observations."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import runpy
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from unittest.mock import patch

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'scripts'))
import s760_runtime

class ObservedRuntime(s760_runtime.NativeRuntime):
    def _start(self,timeout):
        folder=self.config.state_dir.resolve()/'bs1-observer'
        folder.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
        wrapper=folder/'wrapper.lua'
        observer=folder/'observer.lua'
        shutil.copyfile(HERE/'observer.lua',observer)
        wrapper.write_text('dofile('+json.dumps((ROOT/'scripts/s760_runtime.lua').as_posix())+')\n'
                           +'dofile('+json.dumps(observer.as_posix())+')\n',encoding='utf-8')
        launch=subprocess.Popen
        def observed(command,**kwargs):
            command=list(command)
            command[command.index('-autoboot_script')+1]=str(wrapper)
            kwargs['env']['BS1_OBSERVER_DIR']=folder.as_posix()
            return launch([*command,'-log'],**kwargs)
        self.observation_folder=folder
        self.snapshot_count=0
        with patch('s760_runtime.subprocess.Popen',side_effect=observed):
            super()._start(timeout)

    def request(self,operation,**kwargs):
        result=super().request(operation,**kwargs)
        if operation=='frames':
            self.snapshot_count+=1
            tag=f'frame-{self.snapshot_count:02}'
            temporary=self.observation_folder/'snapshot-request.tmp'
            temporary.write_text(tag,encoding='ascii')
            temporary.replace(self.observation_folder/'snapshot-request.txt')
            deadline=time.monotonic()+10
            while not (self.observation_folder/(tag+'.json')).exists():
                if self.process.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError('Observer process stopped')
                if time.monotonic()>deadline:raise TimeoutError('Read-only snapshot timed out')
                time.sleep(.02)
        return result

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--workflow',choices=('stereo','scsi-save'),required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output',type=Path,required=True)
    args=parser.parse_args()
    workflow=ROOT/'scripts'/('verify_native_sampling_input.py' if args.workflow=='stereo' else 'verify_native_scsi_save.py')
    files=[Path(__file__),HERE/'observer.lua',workflow,ROOT/'scripts/s760_runtime.py',ROOT/'scripts/s760_runtime.lua',ROOT/'mame-source/mames760.exe',ROOT/'S760224.IMG',ROOT/'roms/BOOT/Roland_S-760_v1.11.BIN']
    identity={str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in files}
    sys.argv=[str(workflow),'--state-dir',str(args.output.resolve())]
    if args.workflow=='stereo':
        sys.argv+=['--blank-disk',str(ROOT/'docs/ic20-hle-findings/chatGPT-work/media-verification-20261012-065549/formatted.img')]
    with patch.object(s760_runtime,'NativeRuntime',ObservedRuntime):
        runpy.run_path(str(workflow),run_name='__main__')
    assert all(hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==identity[str(p.relative_to(ROOT))] for p in files), 'Input changed during observation'
    (args.output/'observer-identities.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,indent=2)+'\n')

if __name__=='__main__':main()

2026-10-19. **The original memory-based objection is resolved at component level;
BS1 remains REVISE until the complete design is linked and qualified.**
No firmware was released and the original OS, boot ROM and emulator executable
remain unchanged. Mono/stereo and 100 total directory entries remain requirements.

## Measured results

| Checkpoint | Result | Qualification boundary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 42: bounded receive windows | Eight native cases drain full 4 KiB responses while retaining at most 1 KiB; selected offsets 0, 1024, 2048, 3072 and 3960 match, including the 136-byte final window. | 43: actual smaller receive allocation | The same eight cases pass after relocation to a guarded 1 KiB receive buffer. Subsequent HDD load/playback preserves 119,808 PCM bytes and the complete exported image. | Diagnostic resource map, not the final full-client layout. |
| 44: branch compaction | Stereo diagnostic shrinks 1,882 to 1,792 bytes; cancellation after left-channel completion and successful retry pass under note/controller input. All existing PCM, public descriptors and 239,616 pair PCM bytes match. | Only branch forms changed; diagnostic generators/delays remain in the harness. Full production compaction is still pending. |
| 45: in-place stereo split | Input is at most 1,024 bytes. Left samples compact into the consumed input prefix; right samples occupy a separate 512-byte region. 1/511/512/513-frame cases pass both channels and all eight 8 KiB destination/sentinel regions. | 1,536-byte working set; isolated DMA diagnostic, not concurrent transport/publication. |
| 46: guest RIFF validation | Actual guest execution matches the host reference on 88 cases: mono/stereo, eight rates, unsupported formats, malformed structure, every truncation of a small WAV, reversed fmt/data order and odd padding. | Bounded immutable-RAM read provider; no sparse 32-bit or transport-failure acceptance claim. The validator is no longer static-only. |
| 47: file and directory scheduling | Host reference passes 128 WAV cases, including header reads crossing 4 KiB boundaries and repeated access after EOF; status, short and excess responses reject. Twelve pages preserve all original indices of a 100-entry listing with at most 360 bytes per page. | Model only; no guest directory UI or physical Toolbox acceptance. |
| 48: parser plus real SCSI | A 2,126-byte diagnostic links the compact guest validator, bounded receive-window transport and READ(10) adapter. Ten valid/invalid cases return expected metadata/status from private HDD fixtures. | Real guest PIO reads, but READ(10)'s sector addressing is not GET_FILE's block/open-file contract. No full importer claim. |

Every native result includes binary/source identities and ordinary-input execution.
[Validation and reproduction sources](../condensed/validation/bluescsi-workarounds-2026-10-19.json).

## Selected design to integrate

Use one 1,536-byte workspace for paged listing or import. Import uses a 1,024-byte
receive/input region and 512-byte right-channel output region. Store the selected
original entry and path separately; invalidate the visible page before reuse and
refetch it on return. No whole-directory cache is required, but the 100-entry
protocol limit remains unchanged. Frame carry and arbitrary metadata must still
be integrated with the parser and writer.

The protocol returns 4 KiB file blocks. Retain only the requested window while
draining the entire response, then reread as needed. Upstream code opens on block
zero and closes at EOF, so a nonzero read after EOF needs reopening through block
zero. This is included in the host scheduling model. The physical firmware build
still needs qualification. [Protocol documentation](https://bluescsi.com/docs/Toolbox-Developer-Docs),
[current upstream implementation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BlueSCSI/BlueSCSI-v2/main/src/BlueSCSI_Toolbox.cpp).

The cost is bandwidth: four 1 KiB windows require four full-block reads, with
additional reopen/close traffic in some paths. The small-buffer native runs take
376,730–383,612 TIMER1 ticks per full response for the four regular windows.
Their sum is 1,520,716 ticks for 4 KiB retained. These are emulator measurements,
not a physical import-speed promise. No DMA is launched while draining a response.

## Revised memory accounting

| Resource | Bytes | Proposed physical interval, end-exclusive |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| Code, constants and UI ceiling | 5,634 | 003D3E..005340 |
| Shared input/list page | 1,024 | 005340..005740 |
| Right-channel output | 512 | 005740..005940 |
| Existing path/state/CDB/sense/staging/carry allowances | 832 | 005940..005C80 |

The separate 512-byte native-stack allowance remains unproved and is not added
to these local bytes. The new workspace saves 2,560 bytes relative to the old
4,096-byte workspace. Its exact final placement and all combined lifetimes are
proposed, even though smaller receive and in-place split mechanisms passed.

A conservative component census totals **3,749 bytes**, leaving **1,885 bytes**
under the new ceiling. It counts both the transport and pair service routines,
all 831 bytes of retained SDS repairs, the menu resources/index, the parser and
rate table, a READ(10) provider, allocation/writer helpers and a 224-byte wrapper.
It does not assume unqualified sharing. The READ(10) provider is a measured
prototype cost, not a substitute for the missing Toolbox provider. This is not
a complete linked production footprint or a minimum possible size.

## Reuse decisions and remaining gate

- Native menu rendering/input reuse is supported by earlier clone/callback runs; keep private mutable resources. Full list, LCD/controller and navigation behavior remain to be measured.
- Retain the native wave-DMA mechanism through the bounded adapter. Reject unchanged fixed-source, fixed-block and unbounded-wait wrappers as general importer services.
- Keep the bounded private SCSI handshake. Native unbounded waits and CDB-byte mutation prevent counting the existing sender as a safe drop-in replacement.
- Sample initialization and arbitrary descriptor construction remain unqualified; count no speculative savings from them. Existing manual stereo object workflows are reference behavior, not callable ABIs.
- Short conditional branches are accepted where decoded control-flow equivalence and the native regression passed. Do not remove retained error/ownership fixes for space.
- Additional RAM, overlays and a boot-ROM change are held as contingencies. They are neither required by current measurements nor ruled out; decide after the complete integrated build is measured.

The next gate is one integrated implementation/map covering the Toolbox state
machine, general metadata/allocation/publication and browser callbacks, followed
by independent-target recovery and stack/interrupt qualification. Neither the
old 213-byte overrun nor the new 1,885-byte residual is a feature-level verdict.
There is presently **no demonstrated reason to abandon the feature**, and also
insufficient evidence to mark the complete BS1 gate PASS.
'''

"""Relax only emitted inverse-Jcc/LJMP pairs; preserve all control-flow targets."""
import struct,re,pypcode
def relax(a,base):
 old=bytes(a.code); oldlabels=dict(a.labels)
 ctx=pypcode.Context('MCS96:LE:16:default')
 before=ctx.disassemble(old,base_address=base).instructions
 candidates={index-3:(old[index-3]^8,label) for index,label,after in a.fixups if index>=3 and 0xd0<=old[index-3]<=0xdf and old[index-2:index]==bytes([3,0xe7])}
 selected=set()
 def mapped(offset):return offset-3*sum(start<offset for start in selected)
 while True:
  changed=False
  for start,(op,label) in candidates.items():
   if start in selected:continue
   target=oldlabels[label]-base
   distance=mapped(target)-(3 if target>start else 0)-(mapped(start)+2)
   if -128<=distance<=127:selected.add(start);changed=True
  if not changed:break
 result=bytearray();i=0
 while i<len(old):
  if i in selected:
   op,label=candidates[i];disp=mapped(oldlabels[label]-base)-(len(result)+2)
   assert -128<=disp<=127
   result.extend([op,disp&255]);i+=5
  else:result.append(old[i]);i+=1
 for index,label,after in a.fixups:
  if index-3 in selected:continue
  newindex=mapped(index);target=mapped(oldlabels[label]-base)
  struct.pack_into('<H',result,newindex,(target-(newindex+2))&65535)
 a.labels={k:base+mapped(v-base) for k,v in oldlabels.items()}
 after=ctx.disassemble(bytes(result),base_address=base).instructions
 assert sum(i.length for i in after)==len(result)
 starts={i.addr.offset for i in after}
 # Verify decoded branch/call destinations against old control-flow edges.
 afterby={i.addr.offset:i for i in after}
 for ins in before:
  offset=ins.addr.offset-base
  if offset in selected:
   new=afterby[base+mapped(offset)]
   assert new.mnem.startswith('J')
   assert int(new.body,16)==a.labels[candidates[offset][1]]
  elif offset-2 in selected:continue
  elif ins.mnem in ('LJMP','LCALL','JE','JNE','JC','JNC','JH','JNH','JBS','JBC'):
   targets=re.findall(r'0x[0-9a-fA-F]+',ins.body)
   assert targets,(ins.mnem,ins.body)
   target=int(targets[-1],16)
   new=afterby[base+mapped(offset)]
   expected=base+mapped(target-base)
   actual=int(re.findall(r'0x[0-9a-fA-F]+',new.body)[-1],16)
   assert actual==expected,(ins.mnem,ins.body,new.body,expected)
   assert actual in starts
 a.code=result
 a.rows=[dict(pc=i.addr.offset,bytes=bytes(result[i.addr.offset-base:i.addr.offset-base+i.length]).hex(),text=i.mnem+' '+i.body) for i in after]
 a.relaxation=dict(before=len(old),after=len(result),saved=len(old)-len(result),branches=len(selected))
 return bytes(result)
